execution.tests: Build lanes run npm run typecheck and targeted test files only (npm run test:file -- <file>). The full npm test runs only in the merge lane. Never run two full suites at once: cr097 and cr101 bind fixed ports. Run full suites with a short private TMPDIR.
execution.integration: An item integrates only after every upstream item has merged into cli main. In its cli worktree: git merge --no-ff main. On a conflict, the owner's file wins and the item re-applies its own insertions. A conflict inside an existing or red test goes to QA-Red, never the Developer. Then run npm run gen:codex and confirm it leaves no diff, re-run prebuild, typecheck and the item's targeted tests, and run QA-Verify on the integrated tree. If main moves before the merge, integrate again.
execution.codex_generated_companions: prebuild runs build-codex-payload.mjs --check, so a commit that edits a Claude source without its generated Codex copy fails prebuild. Each generated file has exactly one source and one owner: CR-120 owns scaffold/core/.agents/skills/sprint-execution/SKILL.md (rendered from the Claude SKILL.md) and scaffold/hosts/codex/.codex/hooks/token-ledger.sh (verbatim copy); STORY-064-02 owns scaffold/hosts/codex/.codex/agents/reporter.toml.
